concept.analyze.description: Analyze one choice of Card using either the information visible now or a reconstructed retrospective decision.
concept.analyze.detail: The existing Position input, settings, execution, and Results remain unchanged; no real-time speed is promised.
concept.analyze.heading: One decision
concept.learning.automatic: Nothing is imported, selected, analyzed, or built automatically. The summaries describe selected evidence; they do not establish Player truth, Rating, intent, or learned behavior.
concept.learning.description: Explore descriptive patterns across evidence that you explicitly select from recorded Matches.
concept.learning.detail: Use a learning collection only after recording Match data, then choose each saved Match version and build the insights you want to inspect.
concept.learning.heading: Explore several recorded Matches
concept.learning.scope: Multiple recorded Matches and selected evidence
concept.learning.steps.add: Explicitly add selected Matches to a learning collection.
concept.learning.steps.heading: From recording to insights
concept.learning.steps.record: Record one or more complete 36-position Matches.
concept.learning.steps.review: Review or download the resulting summaries.
concept.learning.steps.select: Explicitly choose the saved Match version to use.
concept.match.description: Match Capture is the primary recording workflow for one complete EuroSkat 36er Standard Match with the same three participants.
concept.match.detail: It retains all 36 authoritative positions, including Played Games and Passed Deals, saves locally, and can be resumed. A standalone one-Game Session remains separate.
concept.match.heading: Record one complete Match
concept.review.description: Review recorded Decisions, alternatives, Result, Overbid, Settlement, and selected optional evidence from one completed individual Skat game.
concept.review.detail: A complete 36-position list belongs in Match Capture, not in this single-Game Review.
concept.review.heading: Review one completed individual game
concept.session.description: One Session records one individual Game step by step during play or afterward, can be resumed, and is appropriate for a standalone Game.
concept.session.detail: A Session is not automatically inserted into a Match. Use Match Capture when you are recording a complete 36-position Match.
concept.session.heading: Record or continue one individual game

empty.learning_collections.description: A learning collection brings together selected evidence from recorded Matches for descriptive cross-game summaries. It requires recorded Match data and an explicit collection.
empty.learning_collections.heading: No learning collections yet
empty.learning_collections.next: First record one or more complete Matches in Match Capture, then use the creation form below. Nothing will be added or analyzed automatically.
empty.learning_data.description: This learning collection contains no imported Match data, so it cannot yet provide cross-game summaries.
empty.learning_data.heading: This learning collection has no Match data
empty.learning_data.next: Record a complete Match in Match Capture, explicitly add it here, choose the saved Match version, and then explicitly build insights.
empty.matches.description: One Match records the same three participants across all 36 authoritative positions, including Played Games and Passed Deals, for later review and Learning.
empty.matches.heading: No recorded Matches yet
empty.matches.next: Use Create Match below to start the primary recording workflow for one complete 36-position Match.
empty.sessions.description: One Session is a resumable record of one standalone individual Game, entered during play or afterward. It is separate from a complete Match.
empty.sessions.heading: No recorded individual games yet
empty.sessions.next: Use the creation form below to start one Game, or open Match Capture when you want to record a complete 36-position Match.
